results.title: Pierre Pilote Chex card.jpg
results.description: Trading card photo of Pierre Pilote as a member of the Chicago Blackhawks.  These cards were printed on the backs of Chex cereal boxes in the US and Canada from  1963  to  1965 .  Those collecting the cards cut them from the back of the boxes.  Pilote's card  at PSA.

results.title: Identite-ReneGoscinny-1969-Sacem.jpg
results.description: René Goscinny regarde fixement l'objectif, sans émotion particulière. Il porte les cheveux bruns, coiffés en arrière. Il est vêtu d'un veston gris à rayures plus claires, d'une chemise blanche et d'une cravate noire.
